title: Topological Data Analysis and Link Prediction in Scientific Citation Graphs
summary: Link prediction in scientific citation networks provides an algorithmic mechanism for identifying emerging cross-disciplinary research frontiers. We evaluate topological link prediction heuristics including Adamic-Adar, Jaccard, and Resource Allocation indices across 70 scientific disciplines. By penalizing high-degree hub nodes, the Adamic-Adar formulation achieves an AUC-ROC of 0.887 in predicting zero-hop citation creation across 5-year longitudinal publication windows.
